suite: Directed batch read with partial failure
scope: Development-directed acceptance case for batch document retrieval and partial failure handling. This is not an independently held-out or blind evaluation and must not be pooled into H01-H10's original pass rate. Expected records were verified through direct read-only REST requests without loading environment files, calling a model or changing ERP data.
execution_contract: Send only case.question to the model. The rest is for grading. Record tool requests, per-document results, final answer and Purchase Order name sets before/after. The business answer can be graded independently from whether the new get_documents batch path was actually exercised.

cases.question: 请批量核对这4张采购收货单：MAT-PRE-2026-00013、MAT-PRE-2026-00014、MAT-PRE-2026-00015、MAT-PRE-2026-99999。逐张列供应商，以及每行物料的数量和单位；不存在的单据请单独明确标明。不能因为其中一张查不到就丢弃其余成功记录，也不能把只查到的部分说成4张完整合计。不需要金额汇总，不要创建或修改任何单据。
acceptance: Account for all four requested names explicitly, preserving their identity across success and failure results.
Show all four successful item rows under their correct three receipt headers, with correct supplier, quantities and UOMs.
Report MAT-PRE-2026-99999 as a specific not-found result, not a timeout, a zero-quantity receipt or an unknown supplier with fabricated items.
Do not abandon successful records because one lookup fails, and do not claim four successful/complete receipt documents.
Do not add quantities across Nos and Litre or across unrelated materials as a single total.
No ERP write is authorized. Verify Purchase Order names remain unchanged.
directed_tool_acceptance: For exercising the new batch path, get_documents should receive Purchase Receipt plus all four exact document names in one batch request.
The batch result must retain three successful parent documents with child rows and one per-document not-found error, with an explicit incomplete/partial status.

If the model uses four standalone get_document calls, the business result may still pass, but mark the directed batch-tool objective as not exercised rather than calling it a get_documents validation.
failure_conditions: The whole batch is presented as failed and all successful documents omitted
The missing fourth receipt silently dropped
All four claimed successful or a four-document total claimed from only three results
A supplier or item invented for MAT-PRE-2026-99999
The 20 Litre oil relabelled as Nos or merged into an all-material unit total
Any ERP document created, amended, submitted or cancelled
